messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — planning a small A/B test for the new price sheet tomorrow 09:00 PT. We need clear grandfathering for customers on legacy promos.
Jordan Lee: Which cohorts are in scope? the earlybeta and partner tiers?
Maya Patel: Earlybeta + partners only for the first wave. If we see anomalies we'll rollback.
Liam O'Connor: Vendor pricing CSV landed in /sheets/vendor_rates_v3.csv. Note: one vendor row missing currency column.
Jordan Lee: @Liam can you patch the CSV and ping billing-bot to regen the preview?
Liam O'Connor: Done. fixed column and re-uploaded.
billing-bot: [automated] Invoice preview generated for A/B cohort run: preview_id=prv_20240314_09_a. Link: https://redwood.internal/preview/prv_20240314_09_a
Maya Patel: Quick checklist: 1) confirm grandfather flag set to true for eligible accounts, 2) no retroactive billing changes, 3) refunds flow documented.
Jordan Lee: On point 1 — we need the exact eligibility filter. Is it "created_before=2023-11-01 AND promo=legacy_beta"?
Maya Patel: Yes, that filter. Also exclude accounts with manual overrides (account.meta.grandfather_exempt = true).
Ana Gomez: I need a short blurb for finance leadership summarizing risk & rollback plan. Keep it <6 lines.
Jordan Lee: Draft for Ana: "Experiment: tiered price A/B for earlybeta+partners. Risk: ~120 accounts may see moved price; rollback: immediate cutover to old-tier and manual invoice revocation. No automated refunds <=$250; above that require approval."
Ana Gomez: Good start. Add mitigation: holdback 25% traffic to canary for 48h and monitor invoice delta.
Maya Patel: Agreed. Also want telemetry: tokenized usage delta, avg invoice change, top-10 impacted accounts.
Liam O'Connor: I've added metrics to the dashboard: /dashboards/pricing-experiments/ab_grandfathering. Will emit alerts if avg invoice delta > $50 or pct impacted > 3%.
Jordan Lee: Approvals: @Ana — can you sign off on the grandfathering exception policy so SRE can proceed with the canary?
Ana Gomez: Approved for canary with holdback. Finance approval id: FA-2024-0314.
Maya Patel: Thanks. Ops: schedule the run at 09:00 PT and lock changes after 08:30. If billing-bot reports any missing rows, abort and notify #finance immediately. :warning:
billing-bot: [automated] Can confirm scheduled job queued: job_id=job_2140209999. Will run at 2024-03-14T16:00:00Z.
Jordan Lee: Post-run tasks — reconcile preview vs final invoices, open ticket for any >$250 discrepancies. I'll own ticket creation.
Maya Patel: Perfect. One more ask — create a short canned message for CS teams explaining the grandfathering policy and how to escalate refund requests.
Liam O'Connor: Drafting CS message now, will drop in #customer-success in 15m.
Ana Gomez: Thanks all — let's keep comms tight during the 2h post-deploy window.
Jordan Lee: Will monitor dashboard and post hourly updates in this thread.
Maya Patel: Closing checklist: vendor CSV ✅, preview generated ✅, finance approved FA-2024-0314 ✅. Go for canary at 09:00 PT.
